primitives.name: Formation Topological Morph

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \rho(\mathbf{x}, t): spatial density of offensive agents (agents/m^2), \nabla \cdot \mathbf{v}: divergence of velocity field (1/s)
primitives.assumptions: Continuous fluid approximation of discrete player movements; conservation of mass during the morphological transition.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High-curvature boundary conditions where the sweeping arc intersects the sideline, truncating the intended geometric path.
